## Description

Formulates portfolio weights by optimizing the entropic risk measure (an exponential utility-based coherent risk measure) to account for higher-order tail risks and extreme market drawdowns.

## Where it may fit

Fat-tailed return distributions, high-stress tail risk environments, institutional risk-averse mandates.

## Vehicles

Institutional Asset Management, Risk-Parity Funds, Endowment Portfolios.

## Required data

Historical asset return series, risk aversion tuning parameters.

## Caveats

Convex optimization formulation requires tuning the risk-tolerance parameter to prevent excessive cash hoarding.
